# Linkiir

> Linkiir builds Linkiir Grid, a healthcare integration engine for hospitals, health systems, and healthcare technology vendors.

## Linkiir Grid

- Grid connects, transforms, and routes HL7 v2, FHIR R4 and R5, X12, XML, APIs, and files. Teams can build workflows visually and use Lua for advanced customization.
- Deploy Linkiir Grid on your own infrastructure using Kubernetes, a single VM, or multiple VMs.
- High availability with automatic failover, durable queues, message archives, and replay help teams keep integrations running and recover failed messages.
- The optional AI Assistant helps build, diagnose, and fix integrations. It follows the signed-in user's permissions, and users review proposed changes and approve commits before deployment.
- Linkiir reports 1,000+ interfaces running today.
- Grid supports migration from Iguana, Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf, and other engines. Teams can validate the output before switching routes.
- Grid licensing includes the engine, dashboard, Schema Builder, APIs, archives, scripting, high availability, and migration tooling. AI Assistant access requires an AI-enabled licence and administrator setup.
